}}'''The Excellency''' is an NPC who is first mentioned during {{Quest|Immortal Blaze}}.

They are one of the Overseers of the [[Fractsidus]], though their exact identity is currently unknown.

==Profile==
Although not explicitly confirmed, the Excellency is very likely to be the Fractsidus member mentioned in the diary written by [[Wuli]], described as a strange man in red with a pretentious attitude whom he encountered someplace outside of [[Huanglong]]. Having somehow known that Wuli was traveling in search of a cure for his girlfriend [[Fuling|Fuling's]] condition, he claimed to have a way to save her, and sent Wuli to [[Mt. Firmament]] to help them find the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game.

Although the Excellency later enters the [[Sonoro Sphere]] containing the Temporal Program at some point, they are indirectly injured as [[Changli]] destroys it with her flame manipulation [[Forte]]. They manage to evade capture as well as identification.

==Trivia==
*Due to his authority as an Overseer, The Excellency is suspectedly theorized to be the "uncle" of [[Qichi Village]] (who is responsible for the gruesome experiment to his niece fused with a Tacet Discord), which makes him one of [[The Shepherd]]'s possible identities alongside [[Phrolova]].
